dunedupilat.name: Dune du Pilat
dunedupilat.slogan: Europe's tallest sand dune, with a pine forest at its back.
dunedupilat.line: The dune is about 2.7 km long, 500 m wide and holds roughly 60 million cubic metres of sand.

stemilionmonolithe.name: Monolithic Church of Saint-Émilion
stemilionmonolithe.slogan: A whole church cut out of the limestone beneath the town.
stemilionmonolithe.line: About 15,000 cubic metres of rock were hollowed out to carve its 38 m long hall.

bdxgrandtheatre.name: Grand Théâtre
bdxgrandtheatre.slogan: Twelve columns, twelve statues and a staircase made for entrances.
bdxgrandtheatre.line: Victor Louis's theatre opened on 17 April 1780, with nine Muses and three goddesses on the roofline.

bdxcitedevin.name: La Cité du Vin
bdxcitedevin.slogan: A swirl of glass on the Garonne, shaped like wine in the glass.
bdxcitedevin.line: Designed by XTU architects Anouk Legendre and Nicolas Desmazières, it opened to the public on 1 June 2016.

capferretlighthouse.name: Cap Ferret Lighthouse
capferretlighthouse.slogan: 258 steps up a red-and-white tower at the tip of the peninsula.
capferretlighthouse.line: German forces blew up the lighthouse in August 1944; it was rebuilt almost identically in 1947.
